findings.highlight: As soon as I put my hands down to get up
findings.evidenceJa: 地面に手をついた途端
findings.governingReading: The instant Shirou plants one hand on the ground to rise.
findings.explanation: The English changes the one usable supporting hand established by the preceding wound state into both hands.

findings.governingReading: Together with his heart or spirit rotting utterly away.
findings.explanation: Dying mind removes the decay image and shifts emotional or volitional collapse into cognitive death.
